fit.note: bbinom/mle.hpp, bbinom_mle and bbinom_detail::certify: Fixed-size free-shape profiles use tangent/chord bounds, including the binomial face, with a 1e-8 per-observation face preference; this numerical preference is not an exact nonexistence test. Supported free-size fits use integer tail bounds, including free alpha with beta held; unresolved profile ties and budgets stop. Other free-size profiles remain unsupported.

structural.reason: Estimating size together with both shapes is not implemented. It would require comparing the fits at every finite size, including their binomial and two-point limits, with the negative binomial and Poisson limits, and no usable bound on large sizes is known.

fit.note: betapr/README.md, Details; betapr/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); betapr/test.cpp: Held shape1=1 reduces exactly to certified Lomax and held shape2=1 to inverse Pareto, including all supported further holds and transformed stop bounds. Fixed-scale beta fitting is concave. The joint three-parameter fit and one-held non-unit shape profiles remain numerical.
bhatt/README.md, Details: fixed-shape location-scale objective is strictly concave; the shape grid and face comparison are numerical.

bnbinom/README.md, Scalar certificates; bnbinom/mle.hpp: Every one-free-shape fit has a single-crossing global certificate. Fits with two or three free shapes retain the uncertified multistart search; all-held evaluation is not counted as certification.

cmb/README.md, Details; cmb/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); cmb/test.cpp: Moment matching exploits exponential-family convexity; entropy bounds and integer-tail comparisons certify accepted free-size fits conditionally on the stated numerical margins. Budget exhaustion and unresolved faces stop.

cmp/README.md, Details; cmp/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); cmp/test.cpp: Moment matching exploits exponential-family convexity for fixed design/dispersion subsets; integer-tail or normalizer bounds certify only their stated scope, not every joint numerical solve.
emg/README.md, Details: fixed-shape location-scale objective is strictly concave; the shape grid and face comparison are numerical.

fatigue/README.md, Details; fatigue/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); fatigue/test.cpp: Held beta gives analytic alpha; held alpha gives a monotone scale solve. The joint scale profile is searched numerically; estimating threshold is structurally excluded.

structural.reason: The threshold mu is not estimated, even with alpha and beta held. Supply mu.
The threshold mu is not estimated, even with beta held. A maximum likelihood estimate exists for some held values of beta, but the package does not compute it. Supply mu.
The threshold mu is not estimated, even with alpha held. A maximum likelihood estimate exists in this case, but the package does not compute it. Supply mu.
The threshold mu cannot be estimated. With mu free, the likelihood is unbounded for every sample with a unique minimum, so no maximum likelihood estimate exists. Supply mu.

fit.note: fpareto/README.md, Details; fpareto/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); fpareto/test.cpp: With min held, GB2 on excesses transfers certified Burr and inverse Burr submodels when shape3=1 or shape1=1 is held. The parent held-scale two-shape profiles are also certified by strict scalar concavity. Holding both beta shapes gives a concave power/location likelihood, and holding power and scale gives a concave beta-shape likelihood. Outside unit-shape reductions, free-beta-shape profiles with power or scale free retain numerical searches and face comparisons. Face coefficients refer to excess data.

fit.note: frechet/README.md, Details; frechet/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); frechet/test.cpp: Every subset with mu held is an inverse-Weibull fit (joint concave log profile, held-shape closed form or held-scale monotone shape score). Free mu retains numerical location/profile searches: all regular coefficients free, lambda held, sigma held, or both held.

gb2/README.md, Details; gb2/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); gb2/test.cpp: Held shape3=1 reduces exactly to Burr and held shape1=1 to inverse Burr, including certified joint and held-power routes and stop details; their held-scale two-shape profiles are also certified by strict scalar concavity. Holding both beta shapes gives the concave power/location likelihood; holding power and scale gives a concave beta-shape likelihood. Outside the unit-shape reductions, profiles with shape1 and/or shape3 free while shape2 or scale is free retain numerical multibasin searches and face comparisons.

ged/README.md, Details; ged/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); ged/test.cpp: Held shape at least one gives a convex location problem and analytic scale profile; free shape search is numerical, including uniform-face comparisons.

genbeta/README.md, Details; genbeta/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); genbeta/test.cpp: With endpoint and power held, beta-shape fitting is strictly concave; the free-power mesh and envelope-score search do not certify every maximum.

structural.reason: Estimating scale is not supported. The unrestricted likelihood is unbounded when shape2 is free or below one. With other held shapes, a finite MLE may exist but is not computed. Supply scale.

fit.note: gev/mle.hpp, gev_held_profile and gev_profile: Held xi=-1 has closed-form shifted reverse-exponential fits; held xi=0 and sigma give analytic location. These nontrivial submodels are certified. General free and conditional fits use scalar profiles, finite scans and root discovery without a global enumeration certificate; half-tie face comparisons remain numerical.

huber/README.md, Details; huber/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); huber/test.cpp: Held epsilon gives a concave location/inverse-scale fit; free epsilon is searched numerically with normal and Laplace comparisons.

invtrgamma/README.md, Details; invtrgamma/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); invtrgamma/test.cpp: Held power reduces to gamma and held gamma shape to a concave transformed problem; the free-power/shape profile and face enumeration are numerical.

lst/README.md, Details; lst/certificate.hpp; lst/mle.hpp: All-free fits use exhaustive profile envelopes, root inclusion and uniform curvature neighborhoods, with normal and lower-face certificates conditional on computed practical arithmetic bounds. Held subsets retain their existing exact or numerical routes; general held location/shape profiles remain uncertified.

sged/certificate.hpp certifies free location with both shapes held (scale held or free), and free scale with mean held when xi=1 or nu>=1 is held. Other subsets, including the unchanged default, retain numerical searches without a global certificate; all-held evaluation is not counted.

sgomp/README.md, Details; sgomp/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); sgomp/test.cpp: Held rate leaves a strictly monotone shape score; joint rate grid refines sampled peaks without certifying enumeration of all stationary points.
sn/README.md, Details; sn/mle.hpp: free location and shape use interval and tail upper bounds conditional on computed comparisons; held-location and held-shape solves remain numerical.

snorm/README.md, Details; snorm/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); snorm/test.cpp: Held shape gives a concave location/inverse-scale problem; free skewness uses finite scans and local refinement, not a global certificate.

std/README.md, Details; lst/certificate.hpp; std/mle.hpp: All-free fits use exhaustive profile envelopes, root inclusion and uniform curvature neighborhoods, with normal and lower-face certificates conditional on computed practical arithmetic bounds. Held subsets retain their existing exact or numerical routes; general held location/shape profiles remain uncertified.

tbinom/README.md, Details; tbinom/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); tbinom/test.cpp: Fixed size has exact conditional probability profiling; held probability has integer tail bounds. Free-size/free-probability grids lack a global unimodality certificate.

tnorm/README.md, Details; tnorm/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); tnorm/test.cpp: Fixed-bound likelihood is strictly concave in mean/sd^2 and -1/(2*sd^2); holding mean or sd gives affine restrictions. Free bounds profile exactly to sample extremes; collapse tests are exact. Newton solves and face comparisons use floating-point quadrature and tolerances, rather than a global numerical certificate.

trgamma/README.md, Details; trgamma/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); trgamma/test.cpp: Held power reduces to gamma and held gamma shape to a concave transformed problem; the free-power/shape profile and face enumeration are numerical.

zib/README.md, Details; zib/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); zib/test.cpp: Fixed size has exact conditional probability profiling; held probability has integer tail bounds. Free-size/free-probability grids lack a global unimodality certificate.

zip/README.md, Details; zip/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); zip/test.cpp: Free inflation is an exact clipped profile and the free fit reduces to the zero-truncated rate equation; held inflation uses a numerical rate search without a global root certificate.

zmbinom/README.md, Details; zmbinom/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); zmbinom/test.cpp: Fixed size has exact conditional probability profiling; held probability has integer tail bounds. Free-size/free-probability grids lack a global unimodality certificate.

ztbinom/README.md, Details; ztbinom/mle.hpp (public fitter and held overloads); ztbinom/test.cpp: Fixed size has exact conditional probability profiling; held probability has integer tail bounds. Free-size/free-probability grids lack a global unimodality certificate.
